title: 夜と眠りの時間
subject_en: Night and sleep illustrations in a duotone palette (deep navy blue and warm yellow on cream), each ONE separate object or small scene centred in its cell Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ベッド・枕・月・目覚まし時計など、夜と睡眠の素材12点です。健康や生活習慣の記事、夜のお知らせに使えます。
